source_recipe.rationale: The first gate keeps the art source as a deterministic text recipe so binary transport cannot silently corrupt the PNG. CI records generated SHA-256 values.

normalized.hash_policy: Generated master and normalized PNG SHA-256 values are emitted by CI and checked for repeat-build equality rather than hard-coded here.

runtime_gate.notes: One normalized pose is intentionally reused across runtime states for the first silhouette/pivot/readability gate; this is not an animation-quality approval.
